items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: We mentioned Oscar Brown a few minutes ago. I think it was ’64. You guys did a show at the Waldorf Astoria in New York. [INTERVIEWEE] We did?

ctx.x: Not today. I’m 73 years old. I’m black. What else am I going to be? I’ve outlived my pop days. Still singing the same songs the same way as I did 40 years ago, and today it’s jazz.
We mentioned Oscar Brown a few minutes ago. I think it was ’64. You guys did a show at the Waldorf Astoria in New York.

items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember the chair with Oscar Brown, Jr., in it.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about the shows at the Apollo?
I remember the chair with Oscar Brown, Jr., in it.
